message: The representative sample contains 13 occurrences of references to schemes, equations and a lemma outside PDF pages 243--244. They remain explicit MBUnresolvedReference records; no target was guessed and no number was converted to a false local label.
The sample uses 格式 for scheme; 方案 remains a plausible alternative. The choice is recorded in the book-specific unresolved terminology file and does not alter the global glossary.

The Windows book-worktree checkout has a byte-level directory-manifest difference from the template hash pinned by new-book, while Git reports no changes under template/. The sample was compiled against the verified read-only main-worktree template, and no template file or pinned hash was changed.

The shared-system test test_completed_first_book_is_registered expects the registry to contain only fourier-analysis. It is stale after registration of additional books; 28 other tests pass. Shared tests are read-only on this book branch.

The frontmatter contains 17 references to chapters, appendices, remarks and other targets outside the completed batch. They remain explicit MBUnresolvedReference records until the target units are translated; no target or rendered number was guessed.

Chapter 1 Section 1 contains seven forward or external references whose targets are outside the completed batch. They remain explicit MBUnresolvedReference records; no target or rendered number was guessed.
